title: Last Call
label: 第三关 · 情景长对话
intro: Get the passenger to the right gate.

questions.prompt: Where will the volunteer take the passenger?
questions.promptMeaning: 志愿者会带旅客去哪里？
questions.explanation: B6 是车票上的原检票口。广播里的 will now board at Gate B9 提供了最新信息。
questions.outcome: 旅客赶上了检票。你把最后一项任务交接给下一班。
questions.miss: 显示屏提示检票口已变更。你及时核对广播，把旅客带到 B9。

questions.prompt: What should the passenger have ready at the gate?
questions.promptMeaning: 旅客在检票口应提前准备好什么？
questions.explanation: 最后志愿者说 have your train ticket ready，表示检票前请准备好火车票。
questions.outcome: 旅客备好车票，跟你去 B9 检票。
questions.miss: 检票前你再提醒旅客准备车票。

guide: 听一段完整对话，同页完成两道选图题。
turns: Thanks for finding my bag. Is Gate B6 this way?
谢谢你帮我找回包。B6 检票口是往这边走吗？
Train G7521 to Nanning. My ticket says Gate B6.
去南宁的 G7521 次。车票上写的是 B6 检票口。
Attention, please. Train G7521 to Nanning will now board at Gate B9.
请注意，前往南宁的 G7521 次列车改在 B9 检票口检票。
Boarding has started. Follow me, please. And have your train ticket ready.
已经开始检票了。请跟我来，准备好您的车票。
